name: Access Revoke Approval Reassignment
description: Notifies a user when an access revoke request has been reassigned to them.
subject: Access revoke request for ${requestedForIdentityName} ready for review
body:
Access revoke request reassigned to you

Hello ${newOwnerName},

${previousOwnerName} has reassigned a request to remove ${requestedForIdentityName} from the ${requestedObjectName} #if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role") role #elseif(${requestedObjectType}=="Entitlement") entitlement #else access profile #end to you for approval.

#if($commentText)

${previousOwnerName} provided the following reason for reassigning this request to you:
"${commentText}"

#end

If you approve this request, ${requestedForIdentityName} will lose the ${requestedObjectName} ${requestedObjectType} #if($requestedObjectType == "Role" || $requestedObjectType == "AccessProfile") and all associated entitlements #end.

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
